title: Oxidation of organic films at the mineral–water interface by aqueous-phase ozone affects aerosol light scattering

The study presented here examines how aqueous-phase ozone alters the thickness of organic films at the mineral–water interface of aerosol and estimates the change to aerosol optical properties.
